describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile as a low, quadrupedal animal with a stout, elongated body. Its head is broad, flat and blunt-snouted with large golden eyes and pale pink-tan skin speckled with dark spots on the crown, and multiple feathery pinkish-red external gills project from the neck just behind the head on both sides. The entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the base of the tail and down the sides is covered in overlapping large brown keratinous scales with darker edges and lighter centers arranged in diagonal rows, while the ventral surface, throat, head, legs and tail are covered in pale pink, deeply wrinkled fleshy skin. It stands on four short, thick, splayed limbs each ending in a broad five-toed foot with small claws, and a thick, tapering, wrinkled tail extends posteriorly from the body, partially visible at the left edge of the image.
